description: arXiv:2604.14345v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: LLM-guided search is usually adopted to solve complex tasks by ranking and pruning top-$K$ candidates based on evaluator scores. However, irreducible bias still exists even if popular methods, such as repeated sampling, are applied to reduce variance. Consequently, pruning may remove every continuation that can reach a valid solution. In...
